title: Polynomial ledger bound
statement: For all natural numbers $C,c,c_V,e,c_I,c_P,K$, there are natural numbers $D,f$ such that, for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, $K\bigl(2(n+C(n+1)^c+c_V((n+C(n+1)^c)^e+1)+c_I+c_P(n+1)+1)+1\bigr)\le D(n+1)^f$.
